scope: Correctness of the editor performance changes against the actual merged source, without changing engineering figures or stored fixtures.

venator.method: Load the actual four runtime files from the baseline commit, then Core.buildDesign('venator'); Core.syncCompartments; Core.remount; Core.syncCompartments; figuresDigest(Core.computeStats(ship)). Repeat in a fresh VM with the patched working Core.
venator.inputScope: The after digest was captured with the projection-cache, closed-hatch and combat-summary changes. The final optional enableSurfaceMode report argument was added afterward; Venator has no surface-mode configuration and does not execute that optional path. Its default behavior and the new deferred path were tested separately. The final runtime hashes above describe the released source, not a claim that the digest runner recorded a source hash at capture time.

verified: Repeated cached gunhouse projection performs no asset-coordinate reads.
Fit and envelope edits invalidate projections and match an independent cold calculation.
Closed sliding doors preserve actual figures without building a redundant closed-door clone.
Open and mixed door states retain the original exact armor calculation.
Combat summaries retain all visible fields and do not call either tactical snapshot builder; normal snapshots remain complete.
New wedge, block, cylinder and craft hulls retain authored controls and legacy armor when the unused report is deferred.
After normal worker derivation the complete public state, figures and surface report match; compatibility permissions and the normal report API remain intact.

preExistingFailures.case: venator: computeStats figures match the recorded ones
preExistingFailures.evidence: The independently generated actual-HEAD before digest and the patched after digest are byte-identical, while the stored fixture has different figures. The fixture omits framingMass even though the baseline Core already emits it.

preExistingFailures.case: craft_vulture carries complete ordinary systems without overlaps or flight penalties
preExistingFailures.baselineVerification: Existing test executed against four unmodified runtime files extracted from commit 2e4736db5db242feb39ed033a4a147dc0b78f427
